items.html: It turns out that the Partzufim AA, AVI, and ZON were made of these phases in the seven lower Nekudot after the correction, whether from the phase of the lights or from the phase of the vessels. Indeed, the phases that have Atik Yomin in them rose and mixed with the first three Nekudot, all of which are the phase of Atik Yomin, and Partzuf Atik was made of all those phases, as we will explain.
